title: Repair garages for natural gas- and hydrogen-fueled vehicles.
officialText:
Repair garages used for the repair of natural gas- or hydrogen-
fueled vehicles shall be provided with an approved mechanical ventilation system. The mechanical ventilation system shall be in
accordance with Sections 502.16.1 and 502.16.2.
Exception: Where approved by the commissioner, natural ventilation shall be permitted in lieu of mechanical ventilation.
